SELECT A .ID AS RECORDID, A .STAFF_BADGE, A .STAFF_NAME, STAFF.COMP_NAME, STAFF.DEP_NAME, STAFF.JOB_NAME, A .START_TIME AS STARTDATE, A .END_TIME AS ENDDATE, A .CREATE_TIME AS RECORDDATE, A .PROCESS_ID, A .DURATION AS VACATECOUNT, A .TYPE, A .CAUSE, A .CREATE_TIME FROM SMT_ASK_LEAVE_APPLICATION A INNER JOIN SMT_STAFF STAFF ON A.STAFF_BADGE=STAFF.BADGE
A.STAFF_BADGE LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{query.staffBadge}),'%')
AND A.STAFF_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{query.staffName}),'%')
AND A.CREATE_TIME between to_date(#{query.startTime},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') and to_date(#{query.endTime},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
AND STAFF.COMP_ID IN ( SELECT DISTINCT SPB.COMP_ID from SMT_PARK_BU SPB
SPB.PARK_ID IN
#{id}
)
ORDER BY A.CREATE_TIME DESC
